title: Asahina Mafuyu — Thrown Words〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <K, I made some changes to the lyrics. Can you take a look?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll take a look in a second.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This is really good. They were good before, but I like the new version much more...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, let's see... The chorus and the lead up to it are different!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes. I tried to make it so it matches more closely with Ena's art.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, okay... Yeah, I totally get it! I think I like this version more!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll keep going in this direction then.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, everyone. Do you have a minute...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <For now. I sent you all a rough draft if you could take a look.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's changed from before... The girl hunched over in the rain has a different expression...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me too♪ This is gonna change into that scene where the lights starts shining through the clouds, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The music video's gonna have some good drama to it! Enanan, I wanna get started too so...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know! That's why I'm working so hard!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And how about you, Yuki? What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think the girl is fine... But the background feels like a mess and takes away from it...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So that's what Yuki thinks! I sort of like it how it is now, but everything other than the girl's expression might be blurring together a little.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wait... You're not gonna get mad today?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, yeah. There's no point in getting mad for no reason, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Is it just me or did Enanan seem a little different?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She did. I feel like she's much more relaxed now.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Only a little more time until 25:00. Maybe I should take a short break and... Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Could you take a quick look at that site?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Hmm... Dysgeusia. Discussing It's Symptoms and Causes...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can't you see just by looking? I started wondering and found this after doing a little digging.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Dysgeusia: a distorted or decreased sense of taste... I see. I don't really understand how food tastes either so...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Oh, and... Zinc is necessary for the brain to process the sensation of taste.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Zinc deficiency may occur as a result of a severely imbalanced diet or even stress...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Each of these specific symptoms match up with most of the things that I've been feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Does that mean this is an illness?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I thought that this might help you, so I hope you'll give it a try.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I said it's because I just felt like it, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's not what I'm asking. Why are you being so nice to me?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You've been giving me advice about my art lately, so I thought I should return the favor a little.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <For some reason, everything you say ends up being right...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The thing you said about my draft yesterday... I wasn't sure what to do about the background, and you just came right out with that...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're not much of a smooth talker, but what you say is correct.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Plus, you're a genius and all, so it just seems like a waste to not put your talents to better use.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you start understanding your own feelings more, the songs we make together should also start getting better and better. You'll be helping out K a lot too.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Speaking of which, they were saying that Marionette has the most views out of any N25 song.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I get that your mind and feelings won't get better that quickly, so I started with that site I sent you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's about all I wanted to tell you. How you want to use that site is up to you.>
